howItWorks.title: Citizen Guide: How Grievances Are Resolved

step1.title: 1. Received
step1.desc: Your submission is registered with a unique reference number and timestamped.

step2.title: 2. Reviewed and Routed
step2.desc: The complaint is reviewed and routed to the responsible municipal department within the city jurisdiction.

step3.title: 3. Assigned to Field Team
step3.desc: An inspection officer and maintenance crew are assigned based on priority criteria.

step4.title: 4. Work in Progress
step4.desc: The field unit carries out on-site inspection, repair, or sanitation operations.

step5.title: 5. Fixed and Checked
step5.desc: Completion is verified through photographic proof and field supervisor approval.

howItWorks.privacyInfo: Your personal identity and phone number are kept strictly confidential.
howItWorks.tips: Tips for Faster Resolution: provide an exact landmark, capture clear daylight photos, and report one issue per submission.

privacy.title: Privacy and Data Protection
privacy.automatedTools: Automated Sorting: We utilize secure automated administrative tools to assist in categorizing and sorting civic reports to the correct municipal departments efficiently.
privacy.deleteContact: To request deletion of your account or report records, please contact the municipal grievance nodal officer.
